mechanism.name: AUDJPY_TRIANGULAR_NONARBITRAGE_IMPLIED_SPOT_BASIS
mechanism.economic_hypothesis: Compare last completed EURJPY/EURAUD implied AUDJPY to last completed AUDJPY: basis = (EURJPY/EURAUD)/AUDJPY-1. At UTC t use only original H1 observations ending at t-1 and t-2, all chronologically available. If abs(basis)>=0.0005 and native minimum-size implied displacement >=1.25x precommitted estimated roundtrip spread+slippage+fee, trade the underpriced AUDJPY long or overpriced AUDJPY short on original next M5 t+5 open, close on t+60 original M5 open. No continuation data, param search, zero risk loosening, no multi-leg executable arbitrage claim.
mechanism.distinct_from_closed: Mathematical triangular price identity (EURJPY / EURAUD ≈ AUDJPY), not 4h JPY factor momentum/residual, 3h concordance with contrary AUDJPY, monthly H1 3-asset relative efficiency or quote innovation. All are exhausted prior hypotheses; their signal functions are never called.
